digest.component_or_area: clarity-check gate and plan-review scope extraction
propositions: Two regex patterns and one scope extractor currently key on '## Success Criteria' heading for plan vocabulary detection, making it load-bearing and blocking store migration verification.

The heading-reading code must be repointed from '## Success Criteria' to '## Acceptance Criteria' across gates.py, det_floor.py, and assemble.py to collapse the heading vocabulary and tighten the blocking gate.
The clarity-check bonus for epics must be repointed rather than dropped to preserve the current score of 6 and avoid a live regression across 108 migrated tickets.
Test fixtures embedding '## Success Criteria' must be migrated to '## Acceptance Criteria' with bullets converted to checkbox items where SC was the only criteria block.
The _clarity_score must remain at 6 for epic fixtures after the repoint and be asserted explicitly in tests to prevent future drift.
